description.value: Indian Masala Bistro is an Indian fine dining restaurant located inside the Hilton Hotel at the base of the Whistler Gondola, placing it squarely in the heart of Whistler Village. The kitchen specialises in tandoor preparations, butter chicken, biryani, and both chicken and seafood dishes, supported by an extensive drinks menu spanning craft beers, spirits, Indian chai, and traditional lassi. Takeout and DoorDash delivery are available alongside full dine-in service.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an active Indian fine dining restaurant inside the Hilton Hotel at the base of the Whistler Gondola. The menu page explicitly lists 'Dine-in Menu (Lunch & Takeout)' and DoorDash delivery is promoted, confirming takeout. Vegetarian dishes are highlighted as a menu category. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site. Website address ('300-4293 Mountain Square') is more complete than the OSM value ('4293 Mountain Square'), which omits the unit number.
concerns: OSM address ('4293 Mountain Square') is missing the unit number; website contact page shows the more complete '300-4293 Mountain Square, Whistler, BC' — contact_confirmed.address set to false.

The 'OUR HERITAGE' / grape-growing passage on the homepage and drinks page appears to be unedited website template boilerplate unrelated to this restaurant; does not affect data quality but suggests the site may not be actively maintained.
Copyright dates across subpages range from 2017 to 2020, indicating the site has not been updated recently.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service Indian restaurant inside the Hilton Hotel at the base of the Whistler Gondola is a convenient and substantive meal stop for touring cyclists passing through Whistler Village, with dine-in and takeout options and strong vegetarian coverage.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website features a dedicated 'VEGETARIAN' menu category and describes multiple vegetarian dishes including vegetable samosa, pakoras, and vegetable biryani
